Subject: Re: New vendor setup request — BrightBridge (legal vs remit entity)

Elena —

Appreciate the docs and the note. A few items so we can avoid any PO/invoice routing issues: 

1) We need the exact legal name to use for tax and contract purposes (sounds like "BrightBridge Holdings, LLC"). Please confirm the EIN exactly as shown on the W-9 and confirm whether BrightBridge files as a disregarded entity or a corporation for US tax reporting.

2) For our vendor master, we support a canonical legal name field and a separate remit/trading name + preferred invoicing email. We will record both if you confirm the preferred remit name is "BrightBridge Inc." and AP email is AP@brightbridge.io.

3) Bank/ACH details: our AP team needs the remittance instructions in the vendor portal and an ACH authorization (signed). We can accept DocuSign for the ACH form.

4) PO routing: are POs typically sent to procurement@brightbridge.io or another address? If you have a distinct PO acceptance address, please confirm.

5) If BrightBridge has multiple legal entities across states, please confirm which EIN is applicable for Redwood transactions.

CCing Kimberly (AP) to start the vendor profile creation and Marissa (sourcing) to add any PO-specific notes.

Next steps I'll take: send our vendor onboarding form and DocuSign ACH authorization to you. Once we receive the signed ACH and confirm EIN/legal name, we will create the vendor master record and turn on PO acceptance.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
